4370.title: Catalog fallback changes execution selection
4370.rootCauseOneLine: Verified catalog omissions trigger a default-model substitution that is marked explicit without a user edit.
4370.proposedFix: Decide whether missing current IDs should be retained or require a deliberate replacement; preserve valid new-thread defaults.
4370.caveats: Pure selection/source reproduction repeated twice. Live provider fluctuation and persisted execution were not replayed. No PR because existing fallback policy requires a product decision.
